execution_order: Main forward with current ReBalance steering
Save raw pmax for existing ReBalance observer and full-vocabulary entropy before any logit penalty or temperature
Select active decode rows with H>0.5; exclude prefill and post-think rows
Append tokenized cue to an isolated temporary branch of the exact same accepted prefix
Freeze current steering coefficient/layer on cue; do not update any control history or RNG
Combine raw main and auxiliary logits at scale1.5
Apply existing frozen L27 penalty exactly once
Apply original temperature/top-p and sample once
Update original ReBalance state from saved raw pmax and accepted token only
state_contract: Auxiliary rows keyed by active request identity, never Python requests dict iteration order
Support variable cue token lengths and batch row reordering; cue token count is tokenizer-dependent
Temporary cue must causally attend its own earlier tokens and self plus prefix at every layer
No accepted-token count, lexical FSM, control-history, sampler RNG or prefix KV mutation
Prefix last partially filled block requires copy-on-write; scratch blocks released on success/error/cancel
No auxiliary answer scoring; this is not a correctness verifier
Feature disabled must bypass all transforms/forwards and reproduce native tokens plus control history
